channel.title: Art Ninja
channel.desc: After the local auditions for a TV talent show are cancelled, Gav is out to prove that Bristol's got talent and, with Ricky as a judge, transforms his flat into a studio. While Sarah and Rich make a splash with their singing and dancing, Ricky makes a drum-kit desk tidy, a bowl inspired by Matisse and then uses his skills to make rubbish art that's anything but trashy.
